dashboard.title: ແຜງຄວບຄຸມ
dashboard.description: ພາບລວມແພລດຟອມການຄັດລອກການຊື້ຂາຍພ້ອມການປະຕິບັດຂອງຜູ້ນຳ, ຕົວຊີ້ວັດການສະໝັກສະມາຊິກ, ແລະສຸຂະພາບຂອງລະບົບ.

trading.title: ການຊື້ຂາຍ
trading.description: ງັດການກິດຈະກຳການຄັດລອກການຊື້ຂາຍແລະການສະໝັກສະມາຊິກຂອງຜູ້ໃຊ້.

leaders.title: ຜູ້ນຳ
leaders.description: ທົບທວນແລະອະນຸມັດຜູ້ນຳການຊື້ຂາຍ, ຕິດຕາມການປະຕິບັດ, ແລະຈັດການຄຳຮ້ອງຂໍຂອງຜູ້ນຳ.

subscriptions.title: ການສະໝັກສະມາຊິກ
subscriptions.description: ຕິດຕາມການສະໝັກສະມາຊິກຂອງຜູ້ໃຊ້, ຕິດຕາມຄວາມສຳພັນການຄັດລອກ, ແລະຈັດການການຕັ້ງຄ່າການຈັດສັນ.

trades.title: ການຊື້ຂາຍ
trades.description: ເບິ່ງການຊື້ຂາຍທີ່ຖືກຄັດລອກທັງໝົດ, ວິເຄາະຄຸນນະພາບການປະຕິບັດ, ແລະກວດສອບຄວາມແຕກຕ່າງ.

transactions.title: ລາຍການເຄື່ອນໄຫວ
transactions.description: ຕິດຕາມລາຍການເຄື່ອນໄຫວທາງການເງິນທັງໝົດຂອງການຄັດລອກການຊື້ຂາຍແລະການແຈກຢາຍຄ່ານາຍໜ້າ.

system.title: ລະບົບ
system.description: ເຄື່ອງມືການບໍລິຫານແລະການຕິດຕາມລະບົບ.

audit.title: ບັນທຶກການກວດສອບ
audit.description: ບັນທຶກການກວດສອບທີ່ຄົບຖ້ວນຂອງກິດຈະກຳລະບົບທັງໝົດແລະການກະທຳຂອງຜູ້ບໍລິຫານ.

health.title: ສຸຂະພາບ
health.description: ການຕິດຕາມສຸຂະພາບລະບົບພ້ອມຕົວຊີ້ວັດການປະຕິບັດແລະການຕິດຕາມຂໍ້ຜິດພາດ.

settings.title: ການຕັ້ງຄ່າ
settings.description: ການກຳນົດຄ່າແພລດຟອມລວມທັງພາລາມິເຕີການຄັດລອກ, ຄ່າທຳນຽມ, ແລະການຄວບຄຸມຄວາມສ່ຽງ.

ext_admin_copy-trading.no_follower_money_is_sitting_still: No follower money is sitting still behind an inactive or dormant leader.
ext_admin_copy-trading.nobody_is_following_a_leader_yet: Nobody is following a leader yet.
ext_admin_copy-trading.ranked_by_follower_money_held_still: Ranked by the follower money each leader is holding still

ext_admin_dex.a_position_is_not_revenue: A liquidity position is not revenue
ext_admin_dex.a_position_is_not_revenue_body: It is an asset whose value changes. Nothing on this page reaches the profit report, and nothing here is booked until it is realised and swept.
ext_admin_dex.accrued_at_description: When the swap that paid this fee confirmed.
ext_admin_dex.accrued_vs_onchain_description: What our books say is waiting at each fee-recipient address, against what the chain says is there.
ext_admin_dex.acknowledgement_required_body: Nothing is wrong with this pool. Seeding it makes you the liquidity provider and the counterparty to your users' trades, and that has to be acknowledged before any liquidity moves.
ext_admin_dex.aggregators_missing_credential: {count} switched on with no credential in the environment
ext_admin_dex.aggregators_on_subtitle: Adapters that may be asked for a price
ext_admin_dex.amount_base_units_description: The exact uint256 as it appeared on chain. This is the authoritative figure.
ext_admin_dex.amount_description: In token units. The exact base-unit figure is in the expanded row.
ext_admin_dex.amount_precision_description: How many decimals amounts are shown to.
ext_admin_dex.an_adapter_has_to_be_switched_on_before_: An adapter has to be switched on before anything can be priced. Nothing here holds a key — an aggregator returns a route, and the user’s own wallet signs it.
ext_admin_dex.attention_first: Chains that cannot collect are listed first
ext_admin_dex.availability_group_description: Whether this chain is quoted at all, and how deeply a swap must be buried before it settles.
ext_admin_dex.balances_truncated: Only the largest positions were checked against the chain. Sweep some of these and refresh to check the rest.
ext_admin_dex.binding_key_description: A hash of the exact payload the user was handed. It is what proves a broadcast transaction really is the quote it claims to be.
ext_admin_dex.bought_description: How much the user received, in the buy token.
ext_admin_dex.break_even_volume_body: At {bps} bps to the LP, this is the volume needed for fees to cover the impermanent loss.
ext_admin_dex.break_even_volume_description: How much volume must pass through the pool for fees to cover the impermanent loss. Uses the LP share, not the fee tier.
ext_admin_dex.broadcast_at_description: When the user sent this transaction.
ext_admin_dex.cannot_be_priced: Cannot be priced — which refuses, rather than passing as zero.
ext_admin_dex.cannot_seed_yet: This pool cannot be seeded yet
ext_admin_dex.chain_column_description: Network name and the aggregator path segment.
ext_admin_dex.chain_id_description: Numeric EVM chain id — the only identifier every chain list on the platform agrees on.
ext_admin_dex.chain_not_in_registry: This build has no registry entry for that chain, so nothing can quote on it. Remove it from the scope.
ext_admin_dex.chain_scope_description: Chains this adapter is allowed to quote on. Empty means no restriction and the adapter's own coverage applies.
ext_admin_dex.chain_scope_form_description: Leave empty unless you want to restrict this adapter. Listing chains here can only ever narrow its coverage, never widen it.
ext_admin_dex.chain_status_description: Off means no quote, no build and no swap on this chain, whatever the providers support.
ext_admin_dex.chains_earning_nothing: {count} chain(s) are enabled but earning nothing
ext_admin_dex.chains_off_subtitle: Configured but not offered to users
ext_admin_dex.chains_page_description: The operator overlay over the built-in chain registry. Rows are seeded from code; what you set here is the switch, the fee recipient, the RPC endpoints and the confirmation depth.
ext_admin_dex.chains_quote_only_description: Enabled, but a required piece is missing
ext_admin_dex.chains_with_a_fee_destination: Every chain this build knows about
ext_admin_dex.check_enabled_off: Switched off — nothing on this chain is quoted.
ext_admin_dex.check_enabled_on: Switched on in the chain console.
ext_admin_dex.check_fee_recipient_earning: Charging {bps} bps to the address on this chain.
ext_admin_dex.check_fee_recipient_missing: No valid address. Swaps on this chain are refused until you set one.
ext_admin_dex.check_fee_recipient_set: A valid address is set for this chain.
ext_admin_dex.check_fee_recipient_zero_ack: Deliberately run at zero fee — no recipient needed.
ext_admin_dex.check_rpc_missing: No server-side RPC configured for this chain.
ext_admin_dex.check_rpc_unverified: Configured from {source}, but nothing has confirmed it answers with this chain id.
ext_admin_dex.check_wallet_missing: This build has no wallet network definition for chain {chainId}, so no user can switch to it. Add it to the wallet config and REBUILD the frontend — the list is compiled in.
ext_admin_dex.check_wallet_ok: The wallet layer in this build can switch to this network.
ext_admin_dex.chunks_failed: These block ranges could not be read and were skipped: {ranges}. Re-run them on their own.
ext_admin_dex.confirmations_column_description: How deep this transaction is buried.
ext_admin_dex.confirmations_description: Blocks a swap transaction must be buried under before it counts as settled.
ext_admin_dex.connect_to_sign_description: The platform holds no key for this. Every transaction below is sent from a wallet you control.
ext_admin_dex.could_not_be_settled_description: The fee is on chain and still yours. It is the credit into your books that failed.
ext_admin_dex.could_not_build_plan: The plan could not be built.
ext_admin_dex.credential_description: Whether the environment variable this adapter reads its API key from is actually set on this server. The key itself is never shown or stored here.
ext_admin_dex.credential_missing_title: {envVar} is not set on this server, so every quote through this adapter will fail authentication.
ext_admin_dex.default_slippage_description: The slippage this market opens with, in basis points.
ext_admin_dex.default_slippage_form_description: Leave empty to use the global default. Raise it only for a market that is genuinely thin — a high default costs every user on every trade.
ext_admin_dex.destination_address_help: Where you sent the funds. This is the only address we cannot know.
ext_admin_dex.difference_explainer: A POSITIVE difference is usually fine: the fee recipient is your own address and may hold your own funds, and it can also mean a fee we never recorded. Use the scan below to find those. A NEGATIVE difference is the one to act on: we have booked revenue that is not at the address, which means a sweep made outside this console, or a fee that never arrived.
ext_admin_dex.direct_pool_only_description: This token is routed through your own pool and never offered to an aggregator.
ext_admin_dex.direct_pool_only_form_description: Use for a token no aggregator lists. It means users only ever get the price your pool can give.
ext_admin_dex.each_will_fail_authentication_on_every_q: every quote it is asked for will fail authentication until the variable is set.
ext_admin_dex.enabled_chains_all: No chain is selected, which means every chain switched on in the chain console can be quoted. This is the right state for most installs.
ext_admin_dex.enabled_chains_hint: This narrows what can be quoted. Turning a chain ON is a different control
ext_admin_dex.enabled_chains_restricting: Only these {count} chains can be quoted, even if others are switched on in the chain console.
ext_admin_dex.endpoint_description: An override for the adapter's default API host. Empty means the built-in one is used.
ext_admin_dex.endpoint_form_description: Only set this if the vendor gave you a dedicated host. An unreachable URL here stops every quote through this adapter.
ext_admin_dex.estimated_rows_title: Some rows in this position were inferred from the quote rather than matched to a Transfer log.
ext_admin_dex.every_quote_is_refused_until_one_is_enab: Every quote is refused until at least one adapter is switched on.
ext_admin_dex.every_swap_in_the_window_reached_a_termi: Every swap in the last 24 hours reached a confirmed state, and nothing is sitting past the drop window.
ext_admin_dex.every_transfer_recorded: Every transfer in this range is already recorded.
ext_admin_dex.expires_description: When this price stopped being firm.
ext_admin_dex.explorer_description: Block-explorer base URL used to link transactions.
ext_admin_dex.factory_description: The contract that produced this pool. The trust anchor for everything it claims about itself.
ext_admin_dex.failed_to_load_chains: Could not load the chain list.
ext_admin_dex.failed_to_load_dashboard: Could not load the Swap dashboard.
ext_admin_dex.failed_to_load_requirements: Could not load the requirements report.
ext_admin_dex.failed_to_load_revenue: Could not load the revenue summary.
ext_admin_dex.failed_to_load_wallets: Could not load the fee wallets.
ext_admin_dex.failure_reason_description: Why the credit into your books did not complete.
ext_admin_dex.featured_description: Pinned to the front of the market list.
ext_admin_dex.featured_form_description: Featured markets appear above the rest in the picker.
ext_admin_dex.fee_accrual_description: One row per fee taken on chain, including the negative rows written when a block is reorged out. Read-only: these are observations of the chain, not entries you can author.
ext_admin_dex.fee_bps_description: The platform fee applied to this trade, in basis points.
ext_admin_dex.fee_group_description: Where the integrator fee lands on this chain. There is no global fallback — a chain with a platform fee and no recipient refuses to quote.
ext_admin_dex.fee_mode_description: Which side of the trade this router can take the platform fee on. A property of the vendor's contract, not a setting.
ext_admin_dex.fee_recipient_description: Address that receives the integrator fee on this chain. THE recipient for this network, not an override of anything.
ext_admin_dex.fee_recipient_form_description: An address you control. It is validated as EIP-55 checksummed and stored lowercase; the zero address is rejected because it would burn every fee.
ext_admin_dex.fee_revenue_description: What your swap desk has earned on chain, what you have collected, and where the two disagree.
ext_admin_dex.fee_status_description: Whether swaps on this chain complete and earn. Not the same as Enabled: a chain can be switched on and still refuse every quote.
ext_admin_dex.fee_tier_form_description: Required for V3, where the fee is part of the pool's identity. Taken from the deployment for V2.
ext_admin_dex.fee_wallets_description: Where the platform fee lands on each chain, and whether it can actually land there. An EVM address receives every token with no setup; on Solana each token needs its own account first.
ext_admin_dex.fees_earned_approx_description: Derived from position growth, so approximate by construction.
ext_admin_dex.find_unrecorded_fees_description: A user who closes the tab after signing still pays the fee, but nothing records it. Scan a block range for transfers to your fee recipient that have no swap behind them.
ext_admin_dex.gas_cost_description: What the user paid the network, in dollars.
ext_admin_dex.i_accept_and_take_the_position: I accept and take the position
ext_admin_dex.if_you_had_held_description: The same two amounts, never put in the pool.
ext_admin_dex.impermanent_loss_description: Signed. It is a loss relative to holding, and it is the cost of the fees beside it.
ext_admin_dex.impermanent_loss_stat_description: The cost of earning those fees. Never an opportunity.
ext_admin_dex.in_house_wallets_description: Adoption of the in-house Web3 wallet. Counts only — the platform stores an encrypted backup it cannot open, and keeps no list of customer addresses.
ext_admin_dex.last_error_description: The most recent failure this adapter reported. Historic — it does not clear itself, so check the timestamp before acting on it.
ext_admin_dex.last_screened_description: When this token was last checked automatically.
ext_admin_dex.last_verified_description: When this adapter last answered a probe successfully.
ext_admin_dex.lifecycle_stat_description: Create → seed → retire. Only ACTIVE is quotable.
ext_admin_dex.liquidity_positions_description: Liquidity the operator provided, and whether providing it beat simply holding the two tokens.
ext_admin_dex.listing_description: Your curation decision. Nothing automated ever changes this — only a person does.
ext_admin_dex.listing_form_description: Allowlisted tokens can be swapped. Denylisted is how you retire a token: it stays here so historic swaps remain readable.
ext_admin_dex.logo_url_form_description: Shown beside the ticker. Leave empty to fall back to the generic coin icon.
ext_admin_dex.lp_share_form_description: Leave blank to probe it from the factory's protocol-fee switch. Never defaulted to the fee tier.
ext_admin_dex.market_column_description: The market's symbol, with the quote asset underneath.
ext_admin_dex.market_data_description: Where this market's chart and last price come from.
ext_admin_dex.market_quote_description: What this market is priced in.
ext_admin_dex.market_risk_acknowledgement_description: Version {version}. Every clause is accepted individually, and the exact wording below is what gets recorded — if it changes, seeding blocks until it is read again.
ext_admin_dex.market_symbol_description: Includes the chain id on purpose — the same pair exists on several networks, and a bare symbol would let the chart and the price feed disagree about which one.
ext_admin_dex.n_accrual_rows_awaiting_a_sweep: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing is waiting to be swept} one {# accrual awaiting a sweep} other {# accruals awaiting a sweep}}
ext_admin_dex.n_advisory_items: {count, plural, one {# advisory item} other {# advisory items}}
ext_admin_dex.n_fee_rows_could_not_be_collected: {count, plural, one {# fee row could not be collected} other {# fee rows could not be collected}}
ext_admin_dex.n_rows_could_not_be_priced: {count, plural, one {# row could not be priced} other {# rows could not be priced}}
ext_admin_dex.n_rows_credited: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing credited yet} one {# row credited} other {# rows credited}}
ext_admin_dex.n_swaps_are_past_the_drop_window: {count, plural, one {# swap is past the drop window and still pending} other {# swaps are past the drop window and still pending}}
ext_admin_dex.n_swaps_could_not_be_priced: {count, plural, one {# swap could not be priced} other {# swaps could not be priced}}
ext_admin_dex.native_asset_description: The chain's own coin rather than a contract — ETH, BNB, SOL, TRX.
ext_admin_dex.native_description: Ticker of the chain's native gas currency.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Per-chain readiness: what is enabled, what can quote, and what is still missing a fee recipient, a provider or a working RPC.

routing.title: Routing
routing.description: The aggregators quotes are sourced from, and the chains they are allowed to quote on.

providers.title: Providers
providers.description: Aggregator adapters: activation, priority, covered chains and the env var each one reads its credential from.

chains.title: Chains
chains.description: Per-chain switch, fee recipient, RPC endpoints and required confirmations.

listings.title: Listings
listings.description: What a user is allowed to swap, and between what.

tokens.title: Tokens
tokens.description: The curated token allowlist with screening verdicts, risk flags and per-token on/off.

pairs.title: Pairs
pairs.description: Featured and restricted trading pairs surfaced in the swap terminal.

activity.title: Activity
activity.description: What users actually did: quotes served, swaps submitted on chain, and the integrator fee those swaps accrued.

swaps.title: Swaps
swaps.description: The swap ledger with on-chain status, transaction hashes and block-explorer links.

quotes.title: Quotes
quotes.description: Quotes served, the provider that won each route, and why the others lost.

fees.title: Fees
fees.description: Integrator fee accrued per chain and token, and the sweeps that collected it.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Master switch, fee policy, quote economics, token safety, compliance and the execution poller.

liquidity.title: Liquidity
liquidity.description: Pools this platform quotes from, and the positions the operator holds in them.

pools.title: Pools
pools.description: The pool register: lifecycle, verification freshness, depth, and the calldata to create or seed one.

positions.title: Positions
positions.description: Net versus holding, the quote-asset ledger and impermanent loss on liquidity the operator provided. Never booked revenue.

requirements.title: Requirements
requirements.description: What each chain still needs before it can serve a swap, and a live probe that talks to the chain instead of trusting the configuration.

wallets.title: Wallets
wallets.description: Where the platform fee lands on each chain, and whether it can actually land there. Solana needs a token account per mint; an EVM address needs nothing.

userwallets.title: User wallets
userwallets.description: How many customers created an in-house wallet, and how many have backed up their recovery phrase. Counts only — the platform holds no key and stores no address list.

ext_admin_dex.net_vs_hold_description: Fees minus impermanent loss. Negative means holding would have been better.
ext_admin_dex.no_chain_is_collecting_body: Switch a chain on and give it a fee recipient. Until you do, every swap on it is refused while the platform fee is above zero.
ext_admin_dex.no_chain_is_collecting_yet: No chain is collecting a fee yet
ext_admin_dex.no_chains_description: The chain registry seeds on first boot. If this stays empty, the Web3 Wallet & On-Chain Trading extension row is still disabled.
ext_admin_dex.no_chains_wallet_body: A fee recipient is set per chain, so enable a chain before you can point one anywhere.
ext_admin_dex.no_chains_yet: No chains are registered yet. They are seeded from the code registry on first boot.
ext_admin_dex.no_fee_recipient_set: No fee recipient set — this chain refuses to quote while the platform fee is above zero.
ext_admin_dex.no_fees_on_this_chain: No fees taken on this chain yet
ext_admin_dex.no_keys_here: This addon holds no private keys
ext_admin_dex.no_keys_here_body: Unlike ecosystem master wallets, Swap cannot create or import a wallet — it never signs anything. Set the address you already control as the fee recipient on each chain; the platform only ever renders a transaction for your own wallet to sign.
ext_admin_dex.no_solana_chain_enabled: No Solana chain is enabled, so there are no token accounts to check.
ext_admin_dex.no_unswept_fees: No unswept fees. Everything earned so far has been collected.
ext_admin_dex.non_custodial_banner: Non-custodial · no key held, nothing signed here
ext_admin_dex.not_configured_yet: Not reported yet by this build.
ext_admin_dex.not_set_up_yet_caption: Switched off, with no fee recipient. Nothing to collect and nothing to fix.
ext_admin_dex.nothing_checks_which_contract_a_user_sig: Nothing checks which contract a user is asked to sign
ext_admin_dex.nothing_has_been_quoted_yet: Nothing has been quoted in the last 24 hours
ext_admin_dex.nothing_has_settled_in_the_last_24_hours: Nothing has settled in the last 24 hours
ext_admin_dex.nothing_quoted_in_the_last_24_hours: Nothing quoted in the last 24 hours
ext_admin_dex.on_chain_events_description: Every mint, burn and collect recorded against this position, with the receipt behind it.
ext_admin_dex.on_solana_a_token_is_held: On Solana a token is held by an account owned by your wallet — one per token. Each must exist before a fee in that token can be collected. Creating one costs about 0.002 SOL in rent, refunded if it is ever closed.
ext_admin_dex.only_a_super_admin_can_change_this_setti: Only a Super Admin can change this. Ask one to make the change, or have the role granted to your account.
ext_admin_dex.open_positions_description: Positions with liquidity still in the pool.
ext_admin_dex.operator_seeded_description: Set from the on-chain recipient of the liquidity, never from a form. When true, every user quoting this pair is told the operator is the counterparty.
ext_admin_dex.outcome_description: Whether a price was produced at all. This is the column that explains a user who says swapping never worked for them.
ext_admin_dex.overview_description: Per-chain readiness for non-custodial swaps. A chain has to be switched on, have a fee recipient, be covered by a credentialled aggregator and answer on its own RPC before it can quote.
ext_admin_dex.pair_chain_description: Which network this market trades on.
ext_admin_dex.pair_liquidity_description: Depth behind this market, in dollars, as last measured.
ext_admin_dex.pair_presentation_group_description: How numbers are displayed, and where the market is offered.
ext_admin_dex.pair_routing_group_description: How fills for this market are sourced. Changing this changes the price users get.
ext_admin_dex.pair_status_description: Whether this market is listed, hidden, or retired.
ext_admin_dex.pair_status_form_description: Hidden keeps the market working for anyone with a direct link but removes it from the lists. Delisted retires it.
ext_admin_dex.pair_visibility_group_description: Whether and where this market appears.
ext_admin_dex.pairs_page_description: The markets you surface — charted, streamed and offered in the picker. A pair is presentation, not permission: two allowlisted tokens can still be swapped without one.
ext_admin_dex.picker_order_description: Where this token sits in the swap picker. Lower is higher up.
ext_admin_dex.picker_order_form_description: Lower numbers appear first. The seeded majors run native, wrapped, then stablecoins.
ext_admin_dex.plus_unpriced: Plus {count} position(s) we could not price
ext_admin_dex.pool_address_description: Produced by the factory round-trip, never taken from input. Empty while the pool is still a draft.
ext_admin_dex.pool_column_description: The venue this pool belongs to and the standard it follows. The standard decides the maths, the calldata shape, and whether fees can be booked at all.
ext_admin_dex.pool_create_economics_description: What the position actually earns, which is not what the swapper pays.
ext_admin_dex.pool_create_pair_description: Either order — the canonical sort is applied server-side, and it is frequently the reverse of how you think about the pair.
ext_admin_dex.pool_create_where_description: The chain and the AMM deployment. Only factories this platform already trusts can be picked; adding one is a chain-console change.
ext_admin_dex.pool_detail_description: {venue} · {standard}. Every transaction below is calldata built here and signed by you, from your own wallet.
ext_admin_dex.pool_liquidity_description: Both sides valued in dollars. Blank means the reserves could not be priced — which refuses a quote rather than passing as zero.
ext_admin_dex.pool_rejection_description: Why the last verification refused, if it did.
ext_admin_dex.pool_state_description: How far through create → seed → retire this pool is. Orthogonal to verification: quoting needs both.
ext_admin_dex.pool_token_form_description: A token contract address on this chain.
ext_admin_dex.pool_verified_description: When a trusted factory last confirmed this address is the pool for these tokens. Quoting stops when it goes stale.
ext_admin_dex.pools_page_description: AMM pools this platform is willing to quote from. Filing a pool records it against an allowlisted factory — it deploys nothing, and neither DRAFT nor CREATED is quotable.
ext_admin_dex.position_detail_description: {venue} · {standard}. Real money in versus real money out, then everything that is priced off the pool itself.
ext_admin_dex.position_open_tx_description: The receipt this position was recorded from.
ext_admin_dex.position_opened_description: When the seeding receipt was verified.
ext_admin_dex.position_owner_description: The wallet holding this position. The platform holds no key for it.
ext_admin_dex.position_pool_description: The pool this liquidity sits in.
ext_admin_dex.position_state_description: OPEN, PARTIAL, CLOSED — or ORPHANED, when the opening receipt vanished in a reorg.
ext_admin_dex.positions_table_description: The quote-asset ledger first. Impermanent loss second, and only when there is an independent price.
ext_admin_dex.price_impact_description: How far this trade would have moved the pool, in basis points.
ext_admin_dex.price_precision_description: How many decimals prices are shown to.
ext_admin_dex.prices_render_and_nothing_executable_is_: Prices still render and nothing executable is produced. This is the kill switch, not a configuration error — an operator who pulled it deliberately has not broken anything.
ext_admin_dex.priority_description: The order adapters are tried in. Lower wins when two return an equivalent route.
ext_admin_dex.priority_form_description: Lower numbers are tried first. Two adapters sharing a number is allowed — whichever answers better wins.
ext_admin_dex.provider_column_description: The vendor's display name, with the registry key underneath. The key is what binds the row to its implementation.
ext_admin_dex.provider_description_description: What this aggregator is and where it routes.
ext_admin_dex.provider_routing_group_description: Whether this aggregator is used, and where it sits in the running order.
ext_admin_dex.provider_scope_group_description: Optional restrictions. Both fields are safe to leave alone on a normal install.
ext_admin_dex.provider_status_description: Whether quotes may be sourced from this aggregator at all.
ext_admin_dex.provider_status_form_description: Turning this off stops new quotes immediately. Swaps already broadcast are unaffected and still settle.
ext_admin_dex.provider_title_description: How this aggregator is named in the console.
ext_admin_dex.providers_page_description: Every aggregator this build can quote through. An adapter exists in code and stays off until you switch it on; a switched-on adapter with no credential quotes nothing while looking perfectly healthy, which is why both facts are shown side by side.
ext_admin_dex.public_rpc_description: Browser-side RPC. This one reaches the user's device, so it must never carry a key.
ext_admin_dex.quote_asset_delta_description: Real money in versus real money out, in the quote token. The headline, because it involves no circular pricing.
ext_admin_dex.quote_asset_ledger_body: The only figure on this page with no circular pricing in it. On the operator's own token it can be twice as bad as the impermanent-loss line suggests.
ext_admin_dex.quote_chain_description: Which network this price was for.
ext_admin_dex.quote_fee_bps_description: The platform fee quoted, in basis points.
ext_admin_dex.quote_status_description: What became of the price once it was given.
ext_admin_dex.quote_value_description: The size of the trade quoted, in dollars.
ext_admin_dex.quotes_page_description: Every price served, including the ones that failed. This platform never holds the funds, so these rows are the only record of what was offered, to whom, and under which rules — which is what makes “I could never get a price” answerable.
ext_admin_dex.range_unknown_body: The pool's current tick was unreadable, so whether this position is earning is unknown.
ext_admin_dex.ready_to_collect_subtitle: The address exists and can receive
ext_admin_dex.ready_to_seed_body: Everything checks out and the market-risk notice is signed. The transactions below are yours to send.
ext_admin_dex.reason_credit_failed: The wallet credit failed five times. The transfer is confirmed on chain; check the platform fee log for the underlying error.
ext_admin_dex.reason_currency_not_registered: This token is not in your currency list, so there is no wallet the platform can credit. Add the currency, then re-run the sweep.
ext_admin_dex.reason_rounds_to_zero: The amount rounds to zero at this currency's precision. Sweep a larger amount, or raise the precision for this ticker.
ext_admin_dex.receiving_wallet_description: A wallet you hold personally. Platform wallets are refused: the custodial treasury must never take a market position.
ext_admin_dex.record_sweep_description: Tell the platform about a transfer you have already made, so we can verify it against the chain and credit your books.
ext_admin_dex.registry_key_description: The identifier the router uses to find this adapter's code. Fixed — renaming it would leave the row pointing at nothing.
ext_admin_dex.requirements_description: What each chain still needs before it can serve a swap, and a probe that talks to the chain rather than trusting what is written down. Nothing here is a guess: every green item is something that is configured, and Test is what proves it answers.
ext_admin_dex.restricted_countries_description: Where this market is not offered.
ext_admin_dex.restricted_countries_form_description: Users in these countries will not see this market. Leave empty to offer it everywhere your global rules allow.
ext_admin_dex.risk_description: The automated verdict. Rewritten by the next screening pass, so use Listing to record a decision you want to stick.
ext_admin_dex.risk_flags_description: What the screening pass objected to, in its own words.
ext_admin_dex.risk_form_description: Correcting a false positive here holds only until the next screening run. To make it permanent, set the Listing instead.
ext_admin_dex.routed_through_description: Which aggregator or pool produced this route.
ext_admin_dex.router_description: The swap target and the ERC-20 spender.
ext_admin_dex.rpc_group_description: Two separate fields on purpose: one field for both is how a keyed URL ends up in a JavaScript bundle.
ext_admin_dex.seed_this_pool_description: Amounts and the wallet that will hold the position. Everything else — the router, the factory, the token order, the tick range — is derived here and never taken from this page.
ext_admin_dex.sender_description: The wallet that signed, read from the chain rather than claimed by the client.
ext_admin_dex.server_rpc_description: Whether a server-side RPC is configured, and where it came from. The URL itself is never sent here — Alchemy and Infura embed the API key in the path.
ext_admin_dex.server_rpc_form_description: Server-side RPC, write-only from this screen: it may embed a provider key, so it is never read back. Leaving it blank keeps the value already stored.
ext_admin_dex.shortfalls_description: Booked more than the address holds
ext_admin_dex.showing_n_of_n_swaps: Showing {shown} of {total} swaps that need attention.
ext_admin_dex.sign_blocked_until_accepted: Signing is blocked until the risk notice is accepted.
ext_admin_dex.slippage_description: The tolerance applied, in basis points. This is the one number on a quote the chain itself enforces.
ext_admin_dex.slug_description: Path segment aggregators and indexers address this chain by.
ext_admin_dex.sold_description: How much the user sold, in the sell token.
ext_admin_dex.standard_description: V2 or V3. V2 fees can never be separated from principal on chain.
ext_admin_dex.status_reason_description: Why this transaction ended where it did.
ext_admin_dex.support_can_confirm_backup: You can see how many customers have confirmed their phrase, but not which ones, and not the phrase itself.
ext_admin_dex.support_cannot_recover: A lost recovery phrase cannot be recovered, by you or by us. There is no reset, no override and no support path — the encryption key never left the customer's browser.
ext_admin_dex.support_phrase_works_elsewhere: A customer who still has their phrase can restore the same wallet here or in MetaMask, Phantom, Tonkeeper or TronLink. The addresses and funds are unaffected by anything done on this platform.
ext_admin_dex.swap_chain_description: Which network this transaction was broadcast to.
ext_admin_dex.swap_status_description: Where this transaction got to. The four failure states mean different things and need different answers.
ext_admin_dex.swap_tx_description: The on-chain id. Copy it into that chain's explorer to see the transaction itself.
ext_admin_dex.swap_user_email_description: The account's email, for answering a ticket.
ext_admin_dex.swaps_page_description: Every transaction users have broadcast, and where it got to. A record, not a control surface — the money has already moved and nothing here can change what happened on chain.
ext_admin_dex.sweep_moves_no_money: This form moves no money and cannot. The platform never holds your fee-recipient key. Make the transfer from your own wallet first, then paste the transaction hash here.
ext_admin_dex.sweep_not_mined: Not mined yet. Re-submit once it confirms.
ext_admin_dex.sweep_status_description: Where this fee is between the chain and your profit report.
ext_admin_dex.swept_30d_description: Credited and in your profit report
ext_admin_dex.taker_description: The wallet this quote was bound to.
ext_admin_dex.taker_verified_description: Whether the taker had proved control of that wallet when the quote was issued. Recorded as it was then, not as it is now.
ext_admin_dex.the_amm_deployment_key_uniswap_v2: The AMM deployment key — uniswap-v2, uniswap-v3, pancake-v2.
ext_admin_dex.the_ammdeployment_key_uniswap_v2_uniswap: The AmmDeployment key: uniswap-v2, uniswap-v3 or pancake-v2.
ext_admin_dex.the_confirmation_sweep_has_not_settled_t: The confirmation sweep should have resolved these to confirmed or dropped by now, so this is evidence about the poller rather than about the chain.
ext_admin_dex.the_platform_fee_is_0_bps: The platform fee is 0 bps, so nothing is collected anywhere
ext_admin_dex.the_sweep_has_never_looked: The sweep has never recorded a check.
ext_admin_dex.the_sweep_last_looked_n_ago: It last checked a pending swap {age} ago.
ext_admin_dex.the_transactions_description: Sign each one from your own wallet. Every receipt is read back here and recorded from what the chain said.
ext_admin_dex.these_need_an_operator_before_the_fee_is: These were given up on by the sweeper. Each needs an operator before the fee is recoverable — the money is at the fee recipient, not lost.
ext_admin_dex.this_screen_is_the_only_place_this_key_i: This is the only screen that carries this setting — it is not listed in platform settings.
ext_admin_dex.this_sets_the_price_body: The pool is empty, so nothing can revert and the ratio you supply IS the price. The first arbitrageur takes any mistake, in the first block, irreversibly.
ext_admin_dex.token_address_description: The contract address on its chain. Shown exactly as stored — on Solana, TRON and TON the capitalisation is part of the address.
ext_admin_dex.token_chain_description: Which network this token lives on.
ext_admin_dex.token_column_description: The token's ticker, with its full name underneath.
ext_admin_dex.token_curation_group_description: Whether this token can be swapped, and who decided.
ext_admin_dex.token_decimals_description: Read from the contract, not typed. A wrong value here would be a silent factor-of-ten error in every amount a user sees.
ext_admin_dex.token_notes_description: Internal notes. Never shown to users.
ext_admin_dex.token_notes_group_description: For your team. Not visible anywhere a user can reach.
ext_admin_dex.token_presentation_group_description: How the token appears in the swap picker.
ext_admin_dex.token_status_description: Your switch: whether this token is offered at all.
ext_admin_dex.token_status_form_description: Off removes the token from the picker immediately. Existing swap history keeps resolving through this row.
ext_admin_dex.token_symbol_description: Ticker as shown in the swap picker.
ext_admin_dex.tokens_page_description: What users may swap. Three independent gates decide it — your switch, your listing decision, and the automated screening verdict — and each is shown separately so a blocked token tells you which one stopped it.
ext_admin_dex.transaction_hash_help: We check that this transaction succeeded and contains a transfer of this token, from your fee recipient, to the destination above.
ext_admin_dex.transaction_kind_description: Swaps, and the approvals and wraps that go with them. All four share one ledger because all four need the same confirmation tracking.
ext_admin_dex.trending_form_description: Use for a market you want to draw attention to this week.
ext_admin_dex.type_to_confirm_description: The fee tier is your entire income rate, and on an empty pool the ratio you supply is the price. Both are retyped so both are read once, deliberately.
ext_admin_dex.unbookable_positions: {count} on pools whose fees can never be booked
ext_admin_dex.v2_fees_not_bookable: This pool's fees cannot be booked
ext_admin_dex.v2_fees_not_bookable_body: A Uniswap-V2-style pool mixes fees into principal with no on-chain event separating them. The income is real; it will only ever show as a growing position.
ext_admin_dex.value_usd_description: Priced at the time of the swap. A dash means we could not price this token. It is not zero.
ext_admin_dex.venue_direct_only_warning: Every fill on this market comes from your own pool, with no aggregator competing for it.
ext_admin_dex.venue_kind_description: Whether this went through an aggregator or straight to a pool.
ext_admin_dex.venue_policy_description: How a route for this market is chosen. The one field here that changes where the money goes.
ext_admin_dex.venue_policy_form_description: Inherit follows your global setting. Direct only sends every fill through your own pool with no aggregator competing for it — correct for your own token, costly for a major.
ext_admin_dex.verification_description: RECEIPT means we matched the transfer in the swap's own receipt. ESTIMATED means we inferred the amount from the quoted rate.
ext_admin_dex.verification_failed: The receipt could not be verified.
ext_admin_dex.verified_source_description: Where this token's details came from.
ext_admin_dex.wallet_returned_no_hash: The wallet returned no transaction hash.
ext_admin_dex.what_actually_reaches_the_position_after: What actually reaches the position after the venue's protocol cut, in bps. A projection built on the fee tier instead overstates income by 17–20%.
ext_admin_dex.what_did_not_do_what_the_user_asked: Swaps that did not do what the user asked, and the ones the sweep has lost track of.
ext_admin_dex.what_each_chain_still_needs_and_what_it_: What each chain still needs before it can serve a swap, and what it carried in the last 24 hours.
ext_admin_dex.what_support_can_do: What support can and cannot do
ext_admin_dex.what_the_swapper_pays_in_hundredths: What the swapper pays, in hundredths of a bip. 3000 is 0.30%. It is not basis points.
ext_admin_dex.where_fees_live: Swap fees are not in your profit report until you sweep them
ext_admin_dex.where_fees_live_body: Fees accrue on chain to the fee-recipient address you set for each network, not to a platform wallet. This platform never holds that key, so you move the funds yourself and record the transfer here; only then does the revenue reach your profit report.
ext_admin_dex.who_answered_who_was_signed_and_who_fail: Who answered, who was actually signed, and who failed — last 24 hours.
ext_admin_dex.with_a_recipient_subtitle: A fee destination address is set
ext_admin_dex.wrapped_native_description: Address of the wrapped native token, used whenever a route has to go through an ERC-20 leg.
ext_admin_dex.you_are_the_market: You are the market on {count} of these
ext_admin_dex.you_are_the_market_body: Above the concentration threshold most trades on that pool have you as the counterparty — including the ones your users lose.
ext_admin_dex.you_can_change_this_because_you_hold_sup: You can change this because you hold the Super Admin role. The change is checked again on the server when you save.
ext_admin_dex.you_hold_no_keys: You hold no keys for these wallets
ext_admin_dex.you_hold_no_keys_description: Every wallet below was generated and encrypted in the customer's own browser. The platform stores the encrypted backup and the public addresses, and can decrypt neither. This is enforced by two independent build guards, not by policy.
ext_admin_dex.your_share_description: Your liquidity divided by the pool's. Above the threshold, you are the market.
ext_admin_dex.your_share_of_this_pool_body: Above the threshold, most trades here have you as the counterparty.
ext_admin_dex.zero_fee_description: This chain deliberately charges no platform fee.
ext_admin_dex.zero_fee_form_description: Tick this to run the chain at cost. It overrides your platform fee for this network — swaps here charge nothing even if a fee and a recipient are set.

dashboard.title: ແຜງຄວບຄຸມ
dashboard.description: ພາບລວມອີຄອມເມີຊພ້ອມການວິເຄາະການຂາຍ, ຕົວຊີ້ວັດການສັ່ງຊື້, ແລະສະຖານະສິນຄ້າຄົງຄັງ.

catalog.description: ຈັດການບັນຊີລາຍການຜະລິດຕະພັນແລະສິນຄ້າຄົງຄັງ.

products.title: ຜະລິດຕະພັນ
products.description: ສ້າງ, ແກ້ໄຂ, ແລະຈັດການຜະລິດຕະພັນພ້ອມລາຄາ, ສິນຄ້າຄົງຄັງ, ແລະການຈັດການສື່.

categories.title: ໝວດໝູ່
categories.description: ຈັດລະບຽບຜະລິດຕະພັນເຂົ້າໃນໝວດໝູ່ພ້ອມລໍາດັບຊັ້ນແລະການຕັ້ງຄ່າການນຳທາງ.

reviews.title: ການທົບທວນ
reviews.description: ຄວບຄຸມການທົບທວນຜະລິດຕະພັນ, ຕອບສະໜອງຕໍ່ຄວາມຄິດເຫັນ, ແລະຈັດການການໃຫ້ຄະແນນ.

wishlist.title: ລາຍການທີ່ຕ້ອງການ
wishlist.description: ເບິ່ງແນວໂນ້ມລາຍການທີ່ຕ້ອງການຂອງຜູ້ໃຊ້ແລະການວິເຄາະຜະລິດຕະພັນທີ່ນິຍົມ.

sales.title: ການຂາຍ
sales.description: ຈັດການການດຳເນີນການຂາຍແລະການປະຕິບັດຕາມຄຳສັ່ງ.

orders.title: ຄຳສັ່ງຊື້
orders.description: ປະມວນຜົນຄຳສັ່ງຊື້, ຈັດການການປະຕິບັດຕາມຄຳສັ່ງ, ແລະຈັດການການຄືນສິນຄ້າແລະການແລກປ່ຽນ.

discounts.title: ສ່ວນຫຼຸດ
discounts.description: ສ້າງແຄມເປນສົ່ງເສີມການຂາຍ, ລະຫັດສ່ວນຫຼຸດ, ແລະຂໍ້ສະເໜີພິເສດ.

shipping.title: ການຂົນສົ່ງ
shipping.description: ກຳນົດຄ່າວິທີການຂົນສົ່ງ, ອັດຕາ, ແລະການເຊື່ອມໂຍງກັບຜູ້ຂົນສົ່ງ.

settings.title: ການຕັ້ງຄ່າ
settings.description: ການກຳນົດຄ່າຮ້ານລວມທັງວິທີການຊຳລະເງິນ, ການຕັ້ງຄ່າພາສີ, ແລະນະໂຍບາຍ.

ext_admin_ecommerce.nothing_has_sold_in_this_store_yet: Nothing has sold yet, so there is no ranking to show.
ext_admin_ecommerce.orders_placed_in_the_store_appear_here: Orders placed in the store appear here as soon as they are created.
ext_admin_ecommerce.totals_exclude_unpriced_currencies: No USD rate for {currencies} — totals are a lower bound
ext_admin_ecommerce.what_is_waiting_and_how_the_store_is_sel: What is waiting on you, and how the store is selling.
ext_admin_ecommerce.mixed_currencies_totals_shown_without_a_: Orders use more than one currency, so totals are shown without a unit

ext_admin_ecosystem.a_chain_appears_here_once_it_holds_an_ad: A chain appears here once it holds a customer address or an enabled token.
ext_admin_ecosystem.already_on_chain_do_not_retry: Already broadcast on-chain — never retry this payout
ext_admin_ecosystem.configuration_extension_state_and_the_la: Configuration, extension state, and the verdict of the last stored probe
ext_admin_ecosystem.coverage_appears_once_a_customer_holds_a: Coverage appears here once a customer holds an ecosystem asset.
ext_admin_ecosystem.every_ecosystem_withdrawal_has_settled_o: Every ecosystem withdrawal has settled or is still queued for the processor.
ext_admin_ecosystem.gas_is_flagged_at_or_below_value: Gas is flagged at or below {value}, from ECO_MASTER_WALLET_MIN_BALANCE.
ext_admin_ecosystem.n_payouts_are_waiting_on_a_person: {count} payouts have stopped and will not restart on their own

overview.title: Synopsis

ext_hb.the_signing_secret_will_be_shown: The signing secret will be shown ONCE. Copy it immediately.
ext_hb.the_steps_below_are_still_correct: The steps below are still correct, but the live status badges are hidden rather than guessed at. This retries by itself.
ext_hb.then_watch_it_here_the_bot: Then watch it here — the bot console shows the quotes, fills and inventory it has on our books, live.
ext_hb.there_are_exactly_two_ways_this: There are exactly two ways this site can affect your bot, and you control both. The agent in step 5 relays only the eight commands Hummingbot's own console exposes, it runs only while you run it, and revoking its key ends that channel. Separately, the emergency stop on the bot console disables your API keys and cancels every resting order — it needs no agent, so it works even when nothing else does.
ext_hb.this_is_the_only_time_the: This is the only time the secret is visible. After closing this dialog you can rotate to mint a new one, but the old secret will be destroyed.
ext_hb.this_is_what_the_emergency_stop: This is what the emergency stop does. Re-enabling keeps the same secret, so nothing in your bot needs reconfiguring.
ext_hb.waiting_for_the_first_signed_request: Waiting for the first signed request from your bot. This line updates by itself — leave the page open while you start it.
ext_hb.watch_it_work_in_the_bot: Watch it work in the bot console — your ladder, your fills, your inventory, live from the moment the first order lands.
ext_hb.your_bot_is_reaching_us_and_being_refuse: Your bot is reaching us and being refused
ext_hb.your_bot_runs_on_your_machine: Your bot runs on your machine. These are the four things it needs from us — the connector package, a signed key, this exchange's URL, and a strategy. Step five is optional: run the agent and you can drive it from here too.
ext_hb.your_bot_runs_where_you_run: Your bot runs where you run it, and nothing about your strategy is stored on this side. You still get a window into it: quotes, fills and inventory live in your browser, with a stop button.

ext_p2p.a_bank_account_a_wallet_handle: A bank account, a wallet handle, a PayPal address — whatever you want a buyer to pay to.
ext_p2p.a_dispute_does_not_close_the: A dispute does not close the conversation, and the messages you send after opening one are read alongside everything else. New detail belongs there rather than in an email nobody handling the case will see.
ext_p2p.a_dispute_is_not_a_complaint: A dispute is not a complaint form. It freezes real money and puts a person on it, which is why it is worth knowing what it does before you need one.
ext_p2p.a_five_star_seller_who_takes: A five-star seller who takes forty minutes to release is a worse trade than a four-star seller who takes fifty seconds, and a row of stars cannot tell you that. Release time is the number that costs you something when you get it wrong, which is why it is on the line and a rating is not.
ext_p2p.a_shape_means_every_trader_on_this_metho: Fixed fields mean every trader using this method supplies the same things, and every buyer reads the same rows. It is also what keeps one method from appearing in the marketplace filter a hundred times over.
ext_p2p.a_taker_who_hasnt_paid_by: How long a taker gets to pay. After it you can cancel whenever you like — they can still pay until you do — and your funds come back to this offer.
ext_p2p.a_timeline_a_single_bar_represents: A timeline. A single bar represents the buyer's payment window, which starts when the trade opens and escrow locks, and ends at zero. It carries no scale because its length is set by each offer. At zero the timeline forks, and neither branch is a countdown: if the buyer confirmed in time the clock is finished and there is no clock on the seller afterwards; if nobody confirmed, the trade simply carries on — the buyer can still pay, and the seller can cancel from that point whenever they choose.
ext_p2p.a_trade_has_two_halves_and: A trade has two halves and they move in completely different ways. Almost every problem on this platform comes from not knowing which half is which.
ext_p2p.a_trade_is_still_open_on: A trade is still open on this offer, so the server will refuse to save any change until it finishes or is cancelled.
ext_p2p.a_trade_room_is_private_to: A trade room is private to the two people in it — the payment details and the chat are only ever shown to the buyer and the seller.

ext_p2p.there_is_a_fourth_figure_and_which: There is a fourth figure, and which one you see depends on which side you are on. Selling to somebody, the chip under their name is their payment time — how long they usually take to confirm payment after a trade opens, averaged the same way over their last ten trades. That is the figure a late payment costs you, and it is why the payment window running out does not end the trade.
ext_p2p.there_is_no_fourth_exit_no: Nothing said in the chat is a fourth exit — which is why “release it and I'll sort it out with you after” is always a bad trade. The only hand other than the two of yours that can reach escrow is an administrator resolving or cancelling the trade from the admin side, and that is recorded against their account.
ext_p2p.there_is_one_clock_on_a: There is one clock on a trade and it is always the buyer's. It is counting the window the offer gave them to send the money and say so — commonly fifteen minutes to an hour, and you can see it before you commit to anything. What it is not is a deadline that ends the trade: the window running out cancels nothing by itself.

ext_p2p.two_rails_between_a_seller_on: Two rails between a seller on the left and a buyer on the right. On the upper rail, inside this platform, the crypto travels left to right: from the seller into escrow when the trade opens, then out of escrow to the buyer when it is released. On the lower rail, outside this platform, the cash travels the other way, right to left — from the buyer's bank to the seller's bank — with no point at which the platform is involved.

ext_staking.guide_onchain_intro: Some pools delegate your coins on the network itself. They work differently from the fixed-rate pools this guide describes, and each pool page says which kind it is.
ext_staking.guide_onchain_no_rate_body: You receive what the network paid, minus the commission stated on the pool page. The pool shows what it observed over the last 30 days; that is history, not a forecast, and it can be zero.
ext_staking.guide_onchain_no_lock_lead: No lock and no early exit.
ext_staking.guide_onchain_no_lock_body: You can ask to exit at any time, and the exit then waits for the network's unbonding period. The wait is an estimate and the request cannot be cancelled.
ext_staking.guide_onchain_coins_move_body: A stake takes the coins from your own deposit address on this platform to a staking wallet this platform holds, and delegates them from there. They come back to your address when an exit is released.
ext_staking.guide_onchain_shares_body: Your position is a share of the pool. Rewards raise the value of every share; a validator penalty on the network lowers it for every holder, including you.
ext_staking.guide_onchain_disclosure_body: Every on-chain pool page is generated from the pool's records and versioned. A stake is placed against the version you read, with five acknowledgements this platform keeps on file.
ext_staking.guide_onchain_what_to_expect: What to expect after you stake
ext_staking.guide_onchain_rewards: None of the above applies to an on-chain pool. There is no distribution schedule and no auto-compound setting: the network pays whatever it pays, the platform observes it on chain each epoch, and it raises the value of every holder's shares as it arrives. There is nothing to claim, because the rewards are not a balance this platform is holding for you — they are already yours, inside the pool, and they come back as coins when you unstake. To take only the rewards out, unstake the part of your position they represent; the rest keeps earning.
ext_staking.guide_onchain_risks: In an on-chain pool the reward is whatever the network pays, and it can be zero. A validator penalty on the network reduces the pool's value for every holder. An exit waits for the network's unbonding period, which is an estimate, and cannot be cancelled once requested. While staked, your coins are held in a wallet this platform controls and are not insured.

investment.blocker_already_running: You already have a position running in this plan. You can open another once it settles or is cancelled.
investment.blocker_no_terms: This plan has no terms configured yet, so it cannot be opened.
investment.bounds_none: No limits set on this plan
investment.cancel_confirm_avoids_loss: Your principal goes back to your wallet in full. This plan settles as a deduction at maturity, so cancelling avoids it.
investment.cancel_confirm_forfeits_gain: Your principal goes back to your wallet in full. You give up the return this plan would have paid at maturity.
investment.cancel_confirm_neutral: Your principal goes back to your wallet in full and the position closes.
investment.cancel_returns_principal_note: Cancelling refunds your principal to your wallet in full and closes the position. It forfeits the outcome — there is no partial settlement.
investment.cap_cancel_body: Cancelling a running position refunds the principal to your wallet in full. It forfeits the outcome, whichever direction that outcome was going.
investment.cap_maturity_body: Your maturity date is set when you open the position and does not move. Settlement runs on or shortly after it.
investment.cap_maturity_title: The date is fixed at purchase
investment.cap_one_per_plan_body: You can hold one running position in a given plan at a time. Once it settles or is cancelled, you can open another.
investment.cap_outcome_body: Each plan settles one way: it pays the rate on top of your principal, returns your principal untouched, or deducts the rate from it. Every plan says which before you commit.
investment.cap_outcome_title: The outcome is stated up front
investment.cap_terms_stated_body: A plan's percentage applies once, to the whole term — it is not annual and it is not per day. A longer term on the same plan does not pay more.
investment.cap_terms_stated_title: The rate is for the term
investment.cap_wallet_body: The plan chooses the currency and the wallet type. Funds leave that wallet when you open the position and return to it when it settles.
investment.could_not_load_plan: We could not load this plan
investment.could_not_load_plans: We could not load the plans
investment.could_not_load_portfolio: We could not load your investments
investment.could_not_load_position: We could not load this investment
investment.cta_subtitle: Every plan, its rate, its terms and its settlement rule — on one page.
investment.cta_title: See what is open right now
investment.error_above_max: That is above this plan's maximum.
investment.error_below_min: That is below this plan's minimum.
investment.featured_subtitle: Flagged by the operator as currently popular. Every figure below comes from the plan itself.
investment.fixed_return_disclosure: This is not a managed fund. The rate is set by the operator of this platform and paid from its own funds — it does not come from trading, lending or staking your money. Your capital is at risk and is not covered by any deposit-guarantee or investor-compensation scheme.
investment.funded_from_wallet: Funded from your {currency} {wallet} wallet. The amount leaves it as soon as the position opens.
investment.hero_subtitle: Every plan states its rate, its terms, the currency it takes and exactly what happens to your principal when the term ends. Nothing is estimated after the fact.
investment.hero_title: Commit an amount. Collect at maturity.
investment.how_subtitle: An investment here is a fixed term with a stated outcome, not an account that accrues.
investment.my_investments_subtitle: Positions you have running, how long each has left, and everything that has already settled.
investment.n_not_counted_missing_plan: {count, plural, one {# position is not counted above — its plan is no longer available, so it has no currency.} other {# positions are not counted above — their plans are no longer available, so they have no currency.}}
investment.nav.portfolio.title: My investments
investment.nav.portfolio.description: Positions you have running, how long each has left, and everything that has already settled.
investment.nav.overview.description: What these plans are, how a term settles, and what the platform is running right now.
investment.nav.plans.description: Every plan open for new investment, with its rate, its terms, the currency it takes and what it pays at maturity.
investment.no_plans_match_body: Nothing here matches what you searched for. Clearing the filters will show every open plan.
investment.no_plans_open_body: Nothing is available for new investment at the moment. Plans appear here as soon as the operator opens them.
investment.nothing_running_body: When you open a position it appears here with the time left on its term, the amount you committed and what maturity will do to it.
investment.notice_draw: At maturity this plan returns your principal untouched. It does not pay a return, despite the rate shown.
investment.notice_loss: At maturity this plan DEDUCTS {rate} from your principal and returns the remainder. The rate shown is a loss, not a gain.
investment.notice_win: At maturity this plan pays {rate} of your principal on top of it, and returns both to your wallet.
investment.outcome_not_stated: This plan has not stated what maturity does to the principal.
investment.outcome_not_stated_composer: This plan has not stated what maturity does to your principal, so no projection is shown. Check with support before committing.
investment.plan_error_reassurance: Nothing has changed. This screen simply could not read the plan just now.
investment.plan_not_found_body: It may have been closed or removed by the operator. Every plan currently open is on the plans page.
investment.plan_subtitle: What this plan pays, what it takes, and how long it runs for.
investment.plans_error_reassurance: Nothing has changed — any position you have running is still running. This screen simply could not read the catalogue just now.
investment.plans_from_last_load: These plans are from the last successful load — the most recent refresh failed.
investment.plans_subtitle: Every plan open for new investment. The rate applies to the whole term, and each plan states what maturity does to your principal.
investment.portfolio_error_reassurance: Nothing has changed — any position you had running is still running, and its maturity date has not moved. This screen simply could not read them just now.
investment.position_error_reassurance: Nothing has changed — the position is unaffected and its maturity date has not moved.
investment.position_not_found_body: It may have been cancelled, or it belongs to another account. Everything on your account is on the investments page.
investment.position_subtitle: The term, the maturity date, and what this position settles as.
investment.session_ended_body: Signing in again will bring you straight back here. Nothing has moved in the meantime — any position you had running is still running.
investment.session_ended_sentence: Your session has ended, so this screen can no longer refresh.
investment.settled_deducts: This position deducted the rate from the principal.
investment.settled_pays: This position paid the rate on top of the principal.
investment.settled_positions_explainer: Positions that have matured, been cancelled or been rejected appear here with what each one returned.
investment.settled_returns: This position returned the principal untouched.
investment.sign_in_to_invest_body: Sign in to open a position in this plan. Your wallet balance and any positions you already hold are tied to your account.
investment.sign_in_to_position_body: This position is tied to your account. Signing in will bring you straight back to it.
investment.sign_in_to_see_body: Your running positions, their maturity dates and everything you have already settled are tied to your account.
investment.sign_in_to_see_title: Sign in to see your investments
investment.something_went_wrong_our_end: Something went wrong at our end.
investment.step_choose_body: Each plan sets a rate, a minimum, a maximum and the currency it accepts. The term you pick sets your maturity date.
investment.step_choose_title: Choose a plan and a term
investment.step_fund_body: The amount is debited immediately from the wallet matching the plan's currency and type. If that wallet is short, nothing is opened.
investment.step_settle_body: On the maturity date the platform settles the position under the plan's stated rule and credits the result back to the same wallet.
investment.step_wait_body: Your position shows how much time is left and the exact date it matures. You can cancel before then and take your principal back.
investment.term_sets_date_not_amount: The term sets your maturity date. It does not change the amount — this plan's rate applies once, whichever term you pick.
investment.what_to_expect_subtitle: The rules the platform actually applies, rather than a description of how it feels to use.
investment.will_deducts: At maturity this position deducts the rate from the principal.
investment.will_pays: At maturity this position pays the rate on top of the principal.
investment.will_returns: At maturity this position returns the principal untouched.

support_assistant.guides.browse_the_nft_market.stops.0.bod: I'll show you how to narrow this down to the items you actually want. Nothing is spent while we look — a purchase is only made when you confirm it on the item's own page.
support_assistant.guides.browse_the_nft_market.stops.1.bod: Type here to match an item, a collection or a creator. The results underneath re-run as you type, so there's nothing to press.
support_assistant.guides.browse_the_nft_market.stops.2.bod: This opens category, collection, sort order and a minimum and maximum price. Setting a maximum price is the quickest way to stop seeing items you don't want to spend that much on.
support_assistant.guides.browse_the_nft_market.stops.3.bod: These split the results by how the item is sold. "Buy now" is a set price you pay once; an auction means you place a bid, someone else can outbid you, and it closes at a fixed time whether or not you're watching.
support_assistant.guides.browse_the_nft_market.stops.4.bod: Each card shows the current price and the currency it's priced in — an auction shows the leading bid, not a price you can just pay. Opening a card takes you to the item, where you'll see the full cost including network fees before you confirm anything.
support_assistant.guides.browse_the_nft_market.title: How to find and buy an NFT
support_assistant.guides.choose_a_futures_market.stops.0.b: Futures here are leveraged, so both your gains and your losses are multiplied, and a move against you can close the position and take the margin you put up. This walkthrough shows you how to read this list before you commit anything.
support_assistant.guides.choose_a_futures_market.stops.1.b: Type a coin here to narrow the list to the contracts on it. Only what appears on this page can be traded as futures — holding a coin in your wallet does not mean there is a contract for it.
support_assistant.guides.choose_a_futures_market.stops.2.b: This narrows the list to markets that allow 100x or more, which is the number shown against every row. The higher it goes the smaller the move that wipes out your margin — around 1% against you at 100x — so read it as how much room you have to be wrong, not as how much you can win.
support_assistant.guides.choose_a_futures_market.stops.2.t: What the leverage number costs you
support_assistant.guides.choose_a_futures_market.stops.3.b: The list is ordered by maximum leverage, highest first, so the contracts that liquidate the fastest sit at the top by default. Switch this to Name to browse alphabetically instead.
support_assistant.guides.choose_a_futures_market.stops.3.t: Why the top of the list is not the best of it
support_assistant.guides.choose_a_futures_market.stops.4.b: Each row is a perpetual contract, and picking one opens the trading terminal, where you set your own leverage, size and stop. Nothing is ordered from this page, and the leverage shown here is the ceiling that market allows, not a setting you have to use.
support_assistant.guides.choose_a_futures_market.title: Choosing a futures market
support_assistant.guides.choose_a_staking_pool.stops.0.bod: Staking sets a token aside for a fixed length of time and pays a rate while it is set aside. This page lists every pool that is open right now, and these few steps are how you narrow it down to one that fits you.
support_assistant.guides.choose_a_staking_pool.stops.1.bod: These shortcuts re-filter the whole list in one click. Short lock brings the pools that tie your funds up for the least time to the front, and High APR the ones paying the most.
support_assistant.guides.choose_a_staking_pool.stops.2.bod: Open this to limit the list to one token, or to a rate range. You can only stake a token you already hold, so setting the token here saves you opening pools you cannot use.
support_assistant.guides.choose_a_staking_pool.stops.3.bod: One pool can offer several lock lengths, so this shows the shortest and the longest it accepts — and longer terms are usually the ones paying the higher rate. Your funds stay locked for whichever length you choose, and ending a stake before that date costs a fee, so pick a length you can go without the money for.
support_assistant.guides.choose_a_staking_pool.stops.4.bod: Open a pool to choose your exact term and amount and see the estimated reward first. Nothing leaves your balance until you confirm on that screen.
support_assistant.guides.choose_a_staking_pool.title: How to pick a staking pool
support_assistant.guides.choose_a_trader_to_copy.stops.0.b: Copying means this trader's trades are placed in your account, with your money — their losing trades land in your balance the same way their winning ones do. I'll show you what to look at before you pick someone.
support_assistant.guides.choose_a_trader_to_copy.stops.1.b: This narrows the list to traders running at a risk level you are willing to sit through. A high-risk trader takes larger and faster positions with your funds, so both the gains and the losses arrive bigger.
support_assistant.guides.choose_a_trader_to_copy.stops.1.t: How hard your balance can swing
support_assistant.guides.choose_a_trader_to_copy.stops.2.b: This ranks traders by one figure from their past — return, win rate, or how many people already follow them. It describes trades that are already finished, so a trader at the top of this list can still lose money on the next one.
support_assistant.guides.choose_a_trader_to_copy.stops.3.b: Each card is one trader and the record they have published: past return, win rate, and how many people copy them. Those numbers are history, not a forecast — nothing here promises what your own account will do.
support_assistant.guides.choose_a_trader_to_copy.stops.4.b: Open a trader to read their full record and their terms: the share of your profits they take, and the smallest amount you can start with. You choose how much of your balance to allocate on their page, and you can pause or stop copying at any time.
support_assistant.guides.choose_a_trader_to_copy.title: How to pick a trader to copy
support_assistant.guides.complete_verification.stops.0.bod: This is where identity verification happens. It gates some features, so it is worth doing carefully once rather than three times.
support_assistant.guides.complete_verification.stops.1.bod: Levels are cumulative and each one opens more of the platform. Start with the lowest one that covers what you actually need.
support_assistant.guides.complete_verification.stops.2.bod: If something was rejected, the reason is shown here. Read it before resubmitting — the same document will be rejected the same way.
support_assistant.guides.complete_verification.stops.3.bod: Photograph all four corners, in daylight, with no flash on the plastic. Blur and glare are the two reasons most submissions come back.
support_assistant.guides.complete_verification.title: How to get verified
support_assistant.guides.find_a_transaction.stops.0.body: Everything that has moved in or out of your account is on this page. Let me show you how to narrow it down.
support_assistant.guides.find_a_transaction.stops.0.title: Finding a transaction
support_assistant.guides.find_a_transaction.stops.1.body: Deposits, withdrawals, transfers and trades are all listed here together. Use the filter and search above the table to narrow to one kind — that is usually the fastest way to find what you're after.
support_assistant.guides.find_a_transaction.stops.1.title: Everything, filtered
support_assistant.guides.find_a_transaction.stops.2.body: The status column is what answers 'where is my money'. Pending means it is still on its way and no action is needed; completed means it has arrived and your balance already reflects it. Opening a row shows the timestamps and the reference — if you need to ask us about it, quote that reference.
support_assistant.guides.find_a_transaction.stops.2.title: Reading the status
support_assistant.guides.find_a_transaction.title: How to find a transaction
Here you trade with another user rather than with the platform. The crypto is held in escrow from the moment a trade opens until both sides confirm, so neither of you is ever holding the other's funds unprotected.
This switches between a short list of people picked to fit what you asked for and the full board of live offers. The picks are the top of that same board, so nothing is being kept from you.
This sets which way the trade goes. If you sell, your own crypto is locked into escrow as soon as a trade opens, and you cannot spend it again until you confirm the payment reached you.
Set the asset, how much you want to trade, and how you want to pay. Your amount is checked against each offer's own minimum and maximum, so anyone who cannot handle that size drops out of the list.

Each row is a person who sets their own price, limits and payment methods, so it is worth comparing a few rather than taking the first. Opening one starts a real trade and moves the crypto into escrow.
support_assistant.guides.find_someone_to_trade_with.title: How to find someone to trade with
support_assistant.guides.invest_in_a_plan.stops.0.body: I'll walk you through it, from picking a plan to confirming it. Nothing leaves your wallet until you press the last button.
support_assistant.guides.invest_in_a_plan.stops.0.title: Putting money into a plan
support_assistant.guides.invest_in_a_plan.stops.1.body: The large percentage applies to the whole term, not per year, and the chip beside it says whether the plan settles as a gain or as a deduction — read that before the number. Underneath are the smallest and largest amounts it takes and the currency it is in; open a plan to go on.
support_assistant.guides.invest_in_a_plan.stops.1.title: What a plan is offering
support_assistant.guides.invest_in_a_plan.stops.2.body: Opening a plan takes you to its own page, where you set the amount. That amount leaves your wallet the moment you confirm and stays committed until the term ends — the plan's minimum and maximum are shown under the box, and the wallet it comes from is named at the bottom of the panel. If that wallet is short, the request is refused.
support_assistant.guides.invest_in_a_plan.stops.2.title: How much you're committing
support_assistant.guides.invest_in_a_plan.stops.3.body: On that same page you pick a term. It sets the date your money comes back, not how much comes back — on one plan, a longer term pays the same amount later. Choose the date you are comfortable being without the money.
support_assistant.guides.invest_in_a_plan.stops.3.title: What the term actually changes
support_assistant.guides.invest_in_a_plan.stops.4.body: The confirm button on that page moves the money immediately. If you change your mind before the term ends you can cancel, but a cancellation returns your original amount only and gives up the outcome, whichever way it was going.
support_assistant.guides.invest_in_a_plan.stops.4.title: Confirming it
support_assistant.guides.invest_in_a_plan.stops.5.body: Everything you have open lives on Portfolio, with the time left on each one. Open a position there to see how it settled, or to cancel it while it is still running.
support_assistant.guides.invest_in_a_plan.stops.5.title: Where to watch it
support_assistant.guides.invest_in_a_plan.title: How investing works here
support_assistant.guides.join_a_token_sale.stops.0.body: I'll walk you through picking an offering and putting money into one. Nothing leaves your balance until the last step, so you can follow along and stop wherever you like.
support_assistant.guides.join_a_token_sale.stops.0.title: Joining a token sale
support_assistant.guides.join_a_token_sale.stops.1.body: Only the ones under Active are taking money right now. Upcoming sales have not opened yet and Completed ones are closed — you can read their terms, but there is nothing to buy.
